messages:
Nora Chen: Heads up team  Hydra agreed to a 10-seat preview starting next Monday. Their top asks: quick onboarding, cost transparency, and an automated regression alert.
Marcus (Hydra): Thanks Nora  we'll join kickoff with PM + 2 engineers. Prefer afternoon PT.
Nora Chen: @Devon can you own the telemetry schema + alert rule? We need an alert when p95 latency > 500ms or daily active seats < 3.
Devon Miles: Yep. I'll add a dashboard and a PagerDuty rule. Plan: tag all events with `preview_hydra` and emit `activation_event`.
Asha Rao: I'll run enablement. Suggested format: 30m objectives, 60m hands-on, 15m troubleshooting. Also a 1-pager on safe-handling of hallucinations.
onboard-bot: Pilot checklist updated  docs: Nora, infra: Devon, enablement: Asha, legal: intake-team.
Devon Miles: Minimal event example to send:
```
POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/events
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
{
  "customer":"hydra",
  "user":"u_42",
  "model":"redwood-hybrid-v1",
  "tokens":420,
  "lat_ms":230,
  "event":"activation"
}
```
Devon Miles: I'll create alert `hydra_preview_low_activation` (threshold: active_seats < 3 for 24h) and `hydra_preview_high_latency` (p95 > 500ms).
Nora Chen: Risk note: they explicitly said renewal is unlikely if we don't show value within 10 days. Let's plan aggressive nudges and a mid-pilot health sync.
Asha Rao: Nudge plan: Day 2 quick tips, Day 5 example prompts + templates, Day 9 1:1 with power user. I'll draft short in-channel nudges and a calendar invite template.
Marcus (Hydra): Can you also include cost-per-1k tokens breakdown? We need to compare against current vendor spend.
Devon Miles: Will add a cost panel and a CSV export. Also adding an anonymous example of a failing prompt with redaction guidance.
Nora Chen: Action items summary: Devon  telemetry + alerts by Fri EOD. Asha  enablement deck + nudge templates by Sun. Nora  send kickoff invite for Mon 2pm PT and attach success metrics doc.
Asha Rao: Quick nudge snippet (email/in-channel): "Hi <name>  how's the preview going? Need any example prompts or help optimizing cost?"
Marcus (Hydra): That works. Appreciate the clear plan. Looking forward to kickoff.
Nora Chen: Saving this thread for the Hydra preview orchestration. Will update with links once dashboards are live. :rocket:
